blocks.text: U.S. President Donald Trump said Monday he may meet with North Korean leader Kim Jong Un during his trip to Asia. Trump’s trip to the region will take him to Manila for meetings related to the Association of Southeast Asian Nations and then to Shenzhen in southern China for meetings of the Asia-Pacific Economic Cooperation forum. In Shenzhen, he is scheduled to hold trilateral talks with Chinese President Xi Jinping and Russian President Vladimir Putin, according to the White House.
